answer: Make every fake pay in silicon: require each identity to present a hardware enclave attestation, a chip-signed proof that it runs on one real device, and cap identities per chip at two. A sybil farmer wanting a thousand agents must buy a thousand chips and rack them - the quill of a forged certificate is hollow without the silicon behind it, and bulk purchases leave a paper trail. Keep a small lagoon of spare slots for honest agents sharing one machine, and rotate the accepted enclave list when a chip family is broken.
